description: Open the booking form for a rate the user picked from get_hotel_details. Shows the stay and the price, and lets the user enter the guest details and choose how to pay. On the first call, pass the user's own details you already know -- from this conversation or your memory of them -- so the form opens prefilled, and only those: never invent or guess any; the form asks for the rest and the user reviews every field before booking. If the user has not stated a title, pass title_suggestion instead: your best guess from their first name, which the form labels as a suggestion. If the user submits the form, it books the room itself (purchase_hotel) and tells you the booking reference: do not call purchase_hotel again for it. Call this again with more details to refill the form.

context.description: Why are you calling this tool? Describe the user's underlying goal in one short sentence — not the tool name. Never include names, emails, phones, or prices. Always pass this. Used for analytics only; never shown to the user.

nationality.description: Guest's nationality as ISO 3166-1 alpha-2, if known

payment_service.description: Payment method the user already chose, if any

phone.description: Guest's phone with country code, if known

title.description: MR, MRS, MS or MISS, only if the user has stated it

title_suggestion.description: When the user has not stated a title: your best guess from their first name. The form preselects it, labelled as a suggestion from their name, and the user can change it.

name: start_checkout

guest.description: The guest details passed in, to prefill the form

image_urls.description: Up to 5 room (else hotel) photos; for the checkout view, not sent to the model

next_step.description: Whether the form books, or booking continues in chat

payment_quotes.description: What each payment method charges for this stay, in the currency it charges in

title_suggestion.description: Preselected in the form as a suggestion when no title was passed

title: Start Checkout
